query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM jobs
                   WHERE project_id = $1 AND environment_id = $2 AND destination_id = $3
                     AND generation > $4 AND status <> 'superseded'
               ) AS "newer!",
               coalesce((SELECT max(generation) FROM jobs
                         WHERE project_id = $1 AND environment_id = $2 AND destination_id = $3
                           AND generation < $4 AND status = 'succeeded'), 0) AS "since!"
